# pw

The purpose of `{pw}` is to streamline the use of
[Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) for testing your
[golem](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/) applications.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `{pw}` like so:

``` r

pak::pak("thinkr-open/pw")
```

## Workflow

![](reference/figures/playwright_workflow_setup.svg)

### Requirements

- Ensure that **npm** (with **npx**) is installed on your computer.
- You must be working within a
  [golem](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/) project.
- The default test structure should be present (if not, run
  [`usethis::use_testthat()`](https://usethis.r-lib.org/reference/use_testthat.html)
  to set it up).

### Initializing Playwright Testing

To set up Playwright testing in your
[golem](https://thinkr-open.github.io/golem/) project, execute the
following command:

``` r

pw::pw_init()
```

This function will:

1.  Run `npx create-playwright@latest` in the `tests/playwright` folder.
2.  Add the following files to your project:
    - `tests/playwright/playwright.config.ts` (updated)
    - `tests/playwright/tests/default.test.ts` (created)
    - `tests/testthat/test-playwright.R` (created)

After setup, run `devtools::test()` to confirm that everything is
functioning correctly

### Running the Tests

To execute the Playwright tests, use the following command in R:

``` r

pw::pw_test()
```

### Writing Your Own Tests

To create or modify tests, edit the file
`tests/playwright/tests/default.test.ts` or add new test files in the
same directory to extend your Playwright test suite.

### Running Playwright Commands from the Terminal

For manual execution of Playwright commands, navigate to the
`tests/playwright` directory:

``` bash
cd tests/playwright
npx playwright test
```

## Roadmap

Enable viewing of test reports directly.

**Note:** The full Playwright Node.js API will not be wrapped in R. For
advanced use cases, you may need to run commands directly from the
terminal.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`npx_is_available()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/npx-is-available.md)
  [`stop_if_npx_not_available()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/npx-is-available.md)
  : Check if 'npx' is available in the system PATH
- [`pw_codegen()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_codegen.md)
  : Run the code generator
- [`pw_init()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_init.md)
  : Initialize Playwright
- [`pw_install()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_install.md)
  : Install playwright in an already inited project
- [`pw_show_report()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_show_report.md)
  : Show the Playwright report
- [`pw_test()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_test.md)
  : Run Playwright tests
- [`pw_use_github_action()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_use_github_action.md)
  : Add the Gihub Action YAML for Playwright
- [`pw_use_test()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/pw_use_test.md)
  : Add a new Playwright test
- [`with_test_id()`](https://github.com/ThinkR-open/golemversetemplate/reference/with_test_id.md)
  : Add a data-testid attribute to a tag
